rubrics.justification: Accurately identifies a poor-quality early blastocyst with poorly defined/degenerative ICM and TE, consistent with 0DD; minor issue is speculative mention of collapsed stage and limited comment on zona pellucida.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, endometrium, prior IVF outcomes, diagnosis uncertainty, and semen parameters with the poor embryo morphology to frame prognosis.
Reasoning is logical and structured, with embryo quality appropriately weighted most heavily; minor inconsistency between the 5-15% range and later phrasing suggesting one-in-twenty or less.

Generally aligned with Gardner grading interpretation and standard IVF counseling, luteal support, and cautious use of PGT-A; slight deviation in discussing 0DD notation and some speculative add-ons like sperm DNA fragmentation without stronger indication.

Provides clear practical recommendations for proceeding with transfer, luteal support, expectation setting, follow-up, and future cycle review including embryology, male factor, stimulation, and uterine evaluation.
